findings.summary: isPublished() omits the DEV-mode bypass that the canonical rule in data-utils.ts uses, so it is not actually "the same rule the rest of the site applies" as the task requires.
findings.mechanism: data-utils.ts's isPublished() short-circuits future-date checks when `import.meta.env.DEV` is true, so during `pnpm dev` a future-dated post's own page still renders. The remark plugin's isPublished() has no such bypass, so in dev mode a link to that same future-dated post gets stripped to plain text even though the target page is live and browsable — the internal link disappears in dev while the destination it points to does not, diverging from the rest of the site's behavior that the brief says to mirror.
